messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: Re: [stan-dev] progress report on PyStan 2.4
parts:
I think we should just go to an asynchronous release
schedule, announcing each of CmdStan, RStan and PyStan
as they're ready (and maybe just Stan C++ once we get
that in a more usable state on its own).

As is, RStan leaks out when the Wiki gets updated and CmdStan
gets leaked out when the stan-dev/stan releases get updated.
So technically we're already releasing asyncrhonously.

then there's no pressure on the RStan or PyStan developers to
hustle to tag a new release.

My only concern is that we might miss some necessary backs
and forths where PyStan or RStan require changes in Stan C++.
In that case, we shouldn't be tagging anything or
releasing RStan or CmdStan, even indirectly, until all the versions
are ready to go.

- Bob
